title: Noor and the Veil
author: Ansel Voss
blurb: Ada Delacroix, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
